name: Chamomile
description: Chamomile is a flowering plant known for its small, white ray florets surrounding delicate, feathery yellow discs. It has a long history of use in traditional medicine and as a natural ingredient in skincare and haircare products.
avoid_for: Individuals allergic to plants in the daisy family
Pregnant women due to lack of research on safety during pregnancy
how_to_use: Add chamomile tea bags to your bath for a soothing experience.
Apply chamomile-infused toners or serums after cleansing.
Use chamomile shampoo and conditioner for a healthier scalp.
Incorporate chamomile into face masks or moisturizers.
possible_side_effects: Skin irritation in individuals with allergies
Allergic reactions such as hives, itching, swelling, severe dizziness, or difficulty breathing
scientific_evidence: Studies have shown that chamomile can provide anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties beneficial for skin health. Research also indicates its potential to promote wound healing and reduce inflammation in the scalp.
